measurement_basis: full capability-intelligence test module and static source checks on the committed change

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment session activity capability-intelligence projection

outcome.verified_behavior: The activity projection shares a four-unique-claim lookup budget between structured authority denials and integration-eligibility overlaps. Repeated claim identities reuse the previously read current state; overlap records expose that point-in-time state without changing the recorded preflight eligibility. Compact projections retain one overlap state and report omitted state detail.
outcome.verification_limit: The regression scenario uses controlled session-event and claim-store fixtures. The active campaign projection endpoint was unavailable for a post-change live readback, so this result establishes tested projection behavior, not subsequent agent use or operational effectiveness.

related_work.campaign_objective: Improve MNCS's ability to understand and improve how effectively its language, compiler, tooling, and environment serve and potentiate agents through provenance-linked observations and verified environmental improvements.
related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
